Subject: SSO + webhook integration blocker — can we get an extension/credit?

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our side — we've hit an unexpected blocker in the HelioTech integration. Our SSO handshake with Redwood's SAML endpoint is failing intermittently (we're seeing 403s during the assertion validation step) and on top of that our webhook queue ordering is out of sequence when replaying events from staging. The engineering team tried the usual rotates and token resets but we still can't complete end-to-end tests.

This blocks our demo next week and the engineering sprint that depends on your embeddings/QA pipeline. Given the delay, can Redwood extend our trial window by two weeks and add some sandbox credits so our devs can keep iterating without being rate-limited while we sort this out?

I've attached a short diagnostic extract and our webhook replay logs (see attachment). Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps. We really want to keep momentum here — HelioTech is targeting a pilot decision by July.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Ross
Director of Platform Integrations
HelioTech

Subject: RE: SSO + webhook integration blocker — can we get an extension/credit?

Emily / team — I reviewed the diagnostic extract Marissa forwarded. Short summary from triage:

- SAML: The IdP assertion is using a nonstandard NameID format; our current SAML adapter is tolerant but the library rejects a subset of authn requests under higher concurrency. We can patch the adapter and relax the validator to accept the variation. Estimated engineering work: 3-5 business days to build + test.
- Webhooks: Replay ordering looks like a race when backfill runs at >200 rps while the staging queue inspects new events. A short-term mitigation is to enable per-source sequencing in the webhook dispatcher (feature flag) — low-risk, 1-2 days. Long-term we'll add idempotency keys at enqueue.

So realistic fix timeline: about 7–10 calendar days for a robust fix (including tests). If you need to meet the demo window sooner, the fastest path is to enable the sequencing feature flag in staging and apply a small SAML validator patch. That will be quick but I'd still recommend a week to validate.

Recommendation for commercial support while we deliver:
- One-week extension of trial window (no cost) to allow verification post-patch.
- Sandbox credit top-up: 150k token-equivalent so your devs can continue higher-throughput replays while we validate.

Marissa / Ben — please advise if this package is acceptable; if so Jonas will need to sign off for any credits beyond standard goodwill.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the triage, Kim. Given HelioTech's fit and that this is a near-term pilot decision, I'm comfortable approving a limited relief package. Approve the following under discretionary trial support:

- Trial extension: 7 calendar days from current expiry (one-week extension)
- Sandbox credit: 150,000 token-equivalent top-up
- Conditions: weekly triage sync until full validation and a short closeout note back into the HubSpot deal once resolved

If HelioTech later needs additional runway beyond the one week because the fix uncovers more edge cases, escalate back to me with a short summary and usage stats and we'll consider a second tranche.
